verdict_reason: As a BLME-defined proxy, the implementation exactly computes mean and population standard deviation of cos(h_t, W_out[y_{t+1}]) using the actual output-projection weight and the correct next-token shift. An independent sklearn cosine path reproduced GPT-2 at -0.120083116 versus -0.120083108 (absolute error 8.2e-9), and no value-changing counterexample to that declared estimand was found.
comparable_reason: The raw cosine is dominated by each architecture's ambient unembedding direction rather than target-specific alignment: over seven models Pearson r(raw, cos(h, mean W))=+0.9787, while Spearman rho(raw, target-minus-frequency-matched-shuffle)=-0.286. A fresh four-model fixed-text check retained the inversion (rho=-0.6 versus the shuffled-label margin), and same-width/depth GPT-2 and Pythia-160M reported -0.1201 and +0.9513 despite small target-specific margins (+0.0130 and +0.0102).
github_reason: Fetched AlignmentResearch/tuned-lens, the contextual repository named in task metadata. It trains per-layer affine translators by minimizing KL divergence to the final output distribution; it does not implement final-hidden/target-row cosine, so no released reference code exists for this BLME diagnostic.
paper_reason: The BLME catalogue labels this a BLME diagnostic, and Belrose et al. publish tuned-lens KL/probe results rather than this final-hidden target-row cosine. There is no source-paper scalar this implementation should reproduce.
confounds_reason: The seven-model r=+0.9787 with ambient unembedding alignment and rho=-0.286 with the target-specific margin establish an architecture-geometry proxy. Raw correlations with d_model and n_layers were only -0.350 and -0.277 (n=10), so this is not a simple width proxy; it is a stronger family/head-anisotropy confound.
defects: COMPARABILITY ONLY: no anisotropy or matched-random baseline is emitted, so cross-model ordering follows the ambient residual/unembedding geometry rather than target-specific signal.

INTERPRETATION ONLY: cosine is a row-norm-normalized target logit, not agreement with the model's argmax. For h=(1,0), target W_y=(1,0), and competitor W_c=(100,1), target cosine is 1.0 while its logit 1 loses to 100.
ROBUSTNESS ONLY: an empty or all-single-token population reaches np.mean([]) and returns NaN with a warning rather than an explicit no-valid-token error.
